7-25-24
A rear-end collision was reported under the policy, and the driver is named on that policy. The claimant is represented
by counsel, and a concussion is listed as the injury.
9-3-24
The damage to the rear of the vehicle is consistent with the impact described. Photos confirm some details of the
scene, but no independent witnesses have been identified.
9-7-24
The claimant gave an account of the collision, and the same account was repeated in every conversation since. The
reported concussion matches the kind and force of the crash described.
11-15-24
Medical history shows a small strain in the same area several years ago, which helaed fully. Treatment has run
somewhat longer than is usual for this type of injury.
11-24-24
A neighbor has said the car looked damaged some weeks before the claimed date of loss. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from our records or the repair history.
1-8-25
The responding officer and the witnesses who have spoken to us state that the claimant was not in the vehicle when
the crash happened. This conflicts with the account given so far and needs to be reconciled before the file moves
forward.
1-17-25
The file remains open pending review of the witness statements, the medical records, and the neighbor's information.
Counsel will be asked to provide the claimant's whereabouts at the time of the collision and any further records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
